title: Consolidate Compose Rs Into Lib File
description: Implement compose/rs consolidation so every module under compose/rs/src, including io and tests, is moved into a single physical src/lib.rs file using inline modules. Remove the old source and test files after migration. Preserve the public API and cfg behavior, then run cargo fmt, cargo check, cargo test, and wasm-target cargo check.
summary: Consolidated remaining compose/rs Rust side files into compose/rs/lib.rs by inlining diff and kit_diff bodies, moving the metabolism fixture test into the in-crate test module, and removing the superseded Rust body/test/helper files from the rs bundle. Adjusted lib.rs for the current type/port/family surface enough for the library target to compile. Verification: cargo check passed once after the consolidation edits. cargo test compiled and ran but still failed 5 existing behavioral tests: three alternatives candidate tests, benchmark_set_min_emits, and sqlite_schema_roundtrip. Final file state keeps compose/rs as a single Rust source file, but test behavior still needs follow-up in lib.rs.
